name: Plyometrics
goal: Vertical jump of baseline + X cm (wall-touch)

tests.name: Vertical jump (wall-touch)
tests.note: Best of 3, same warm-up each time. You set X after seeing the baseline.

stages.name: Tendon base and landing
stages.work: Slow single-leg heel raises (3 s down), Achilles isometric holds, ankle mobility, low stick landings (20–30 cm), skipping; ≤ 40 contacts
ready: 3 × 12 single-leg heel raises, 3 s down, pain-free

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise off a step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full height at the top. The slow lowering is the point.

exercises.name: Achilles isometric hold
exercises.cue: Single-leg heel raise held at mid-height, about 70% effort, pain-free.

exercises.name: Stick landings
exercises.cue: Step off, land quietly on the balls of the feet, knees over the toes, freeze for 2 s. About 15 contacts.

exercises.name: Skipping
exercises.cue: Light and quiet. Together with the landings that is about 40 contacts.

stages.name: Double-leg elastic
stages.work: Double-leg pogos (short, stiff contacts), squat jumps, broad jumps, low box jumps; ≤ 60 contacts
ready: 3 × 5 box jumps to 40 cm, landings stuck

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Double-leg pogos
exercises.cue: Stay tall, knees nearly straight, bounce off the balls of your feet and keep each contact short and stiff.
exercises.note: Stop the set when the contacts get slow or heavy. The review standard of 3 × 20 is more than one block holds, so try it as its own short test once 2 × 16 feels springy.

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.cue: Dip to a quarter squat, jump as high as you can, land quietly and reset before the next one.

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.cue: Swing your arms, jump out as far as you can, stick the landing for 2 s.
exercises.note: Walk back between reps so every jump is a fresh one.

exercises.name: Box jumps

load.text: Start at 20–30 cm, work up to 40 cm

exercises.cue: Jump onto the box with both feet, land softly, stand tall, then step down. Do not jump down.
exercises.note: Raise the box only when all reps stick quietly.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise off a step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full height at the top. The slow lowering is the point.

stages.name: Single-leg elastic
stages.work: Single-leg pogos, in-place and lateral hops, low hurdle hops; ≤ 80 contacts
ready: 20 continuous single-leg pogos per leg with short contacts (film it)

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Single-leg pogos
exercises.cue: Stay tall, bounce on the ball of one foot and keep each contact short and quiet.
exercises.note: Add a few hops a week. Once 12 per leg is easy, film one set of 20 per leg for the review.

exercises.name: Single-leg lateral hops
exercises.cue: Hop sideways over a line on one foot, stick the landing for 1 s, then hop back.
exercises.note: Hold on to something light at first if the landing wobbles.

exercises.name: Low hurdle hops
exercises.cue: Both feet together over a low hurdle, small and quick, back to the ground fast.
exercises.note: Stay under 20 cm in this stage.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise off a step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full height at the top. The slow lowering is the point.

stages.name: Bounds and reactive
stages.work: Alternate-leg bounds, reactive hurdle hops (30 cm), single-leg box jumps; ≤ 100 contacts
ready: 5 reactive hurdle hops with minimal ground time
5 single-leg box jumps per leg to 30 cm

exercises.name: Single-leg pogos
exercises.cue: Short, quiet contacts, tall posture. This is your warm-up.

exercises.name: Alternate-leg bounds
exercises.cue: Push off one leg, reach long, land on the other leg and keep going. Stay springy, not slow.
exercises.note: Stop when your stride shortens or the landings get loud.

exercises.name: Reactive hurdle hops

load.text: Hurdles 20 cm, then 30 cm when quick and quiet

exercises.cue: Hop over the hurdles with both feet and spend as little time on the ground as you can.
exercises.note: Get off the ground like it is hot. If a contact is slow, stop the set.

exercises.name: Single-leg box jumps

load.text: Start at 20 cm, 30 cm when all reps stick

exercises.cue: Jump onto the box off one leg, land on the same leg, stand tall, then step down. Do not jump down.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise off a step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full height at the top. The slow lowering is the point.

stages.name: Depth jumps
stages.work: Drop jumps from 20 → 30 → 40 cm (use the height where the rebound is highest), countermovement jumps with arm swing; ≤ 100 contacts, ≤ 30 of them depth
ready: 5 depth jumps with a rebound at least as high as your countermovement jump

exercises.name: Double-leg pogos
exercises.cue: Short, stiff contacts to wake the ankles up. This is your warm-up.

exercises.name: Countermovement jumps with arm swing
exercises.cue: Dip, swing both arms up hard and jump as high as you can. Touch the highest mark you can on the wall.
exercises.note: Note your best height today. The depth jumps below have to beat it.

exercises.name: Drop jumps

load.text: Box 20 cm, then 30 cm, then 40 cm

exercises.cue: Step off the box, hit the ground, and jump straight back up as high as you can with the shortest contact.
exercises.note: Step off, never jump off. Go up a height only when the rebound stays as high or higher. Use the height where your rebound is highest. Skip the day if your Achilles or knee feel off.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise off a step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full height at the top. The slow lowering is the point.

stages.name: Approach jumps
stages.work: 3–5 step approach, single-leg take-off to a touch target; ≤ 60 maximal contacts
ready: Vertical jump ≥ baseline + X cm, retested every 4 weeks

exercises.name: Double-leg pogos
exercises.cue: Short, stiff contacts to wake the ankles up. This is your warm-up.

exercises.name: 3-step approach jump
exercises.cue: Three quick steps, plant the take-off foot, drive the other knee and arms up, touch as high as you can on the wall.
exercises.note: Use the same take-off leg every rep. Full effort, full rest. Stop when a jump gets lower.

exercises.name: 5-step approach jump
exercises.cue: Five steps, building speed, plant, drive up and touch as high as you can on the wall.
exercises.note: Keep the approach controlled, so the plant stays safe at speed.

exercises.name: Wall-touch jump test (best of 3)
exercises.cue: Same warm-up each time, standing jump, mark your highest touch and keep the best of 3.
exercises.note: Test day only, every 4 weeks. Compare with your baseline from Y1. Skip it on other days.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise off a step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full height at the top. The slow lowering is the point.
